import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ba412da2.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    line_r = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != grid[0][0])
    line_color = grid[line_r][0]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    obj = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,line_color,8)]
    if not obj:
        return out
    rs = [r for r,c,v in obj]
    top, bottom = min(rs), max(rs)
    # Move the colored pattern to the line, preserving its shape.
    if bottom < line_r:
        shift = line_r - 1 - bottom
        marker_r = top + shift - 1
    else:
        shift = line_r + 1 - top
        marker_r = bottom + shift + 1
    for r,c,v in obj:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r,c,v in obj:
        nr = r + shift
        if 0 <= nr < h and nr != line_r:
            out[nr][c] = v
    if 0 <= marker_r < h and marker_r != line_r:
        out[marker_r] = [8] * w
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
# verify demos parsed manually representative geometry
print(p, os.path.exists(p))
